'''MD-5''' was an [[MD-5 medical droid]] assigned to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]. Its service carried over once the ship's crew [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|mutined]] and took over control of the vessel. MD-5 was the ship's general practitioner droid, performing regular check ups on the crew and minor surgical procedures. The droid was assisted by [[MD-0]], who saw the patients and diagnosed them prior to MD-5 seeing them.<ref name="FOP" />
